
{{alias}}( x, n, b )
    Rounds a single-precision floating-point number toward zero to `n` digits
    in base `b`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: number
        Input value.

    n: integer
        Number of digits.

    b: integer
        Base.

    Returns
    -------
    y: number
        Rounded value.

    Examples
    --------
    > var y = {{alias}}( 3.14159, 2, 10 )
    ~3.14
    > y = {{alias}}( 3.14159, 3, 10 )
    ~3.141
    > y = {{alias}}( 15.0, -1, 10 )
    10.0
    > y = {{alias}}( -3.14159, 2, 10 )
    ~-3.14
    > y = {{alias}}( {{alias:@stdlib/constants/float32/pinf}}, 2, 10 )
    Infinity
    > y = {{alias}}( {{alias:@stdlib/constants/float32/ninf}}, 2, 10 )
    -Infinity
    > y = {{alias}}( NaN, 2, 10 )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
